=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:1296-1301 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When cached meta.json carries job["diagnostics"] but the on-disk job-[id].txt was removed by _enforce_total_budget between the prior collect and the new one, the loop recomputes _job_diagnostics from the missing log file at line 1300, which raises FileNotFoundError.
  WHY: A re-collect after _enforce_total_budget deleted the cached job-[id].txt will raise FileNotFoundError from Path.read_text at line 1300. The _cmd_collect wrapper catches (OSError, ValueError) and logs collect_failed, so the stage fails open with {"collected": False, "reason": "collect_failed"}. The evidence folder is then missing the job log for that run in the next stage, and the diagnostics for that job will be {} in diagnostics.json. The next stage still produces a usable INDEX.md; this is observable as a single warn collect_failed line and an empty diagnostics.json for that run. This is a TOCTOU race in single-threaded code, extremely unlikely in practice, and fails open correctly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
